discrete-multi-unit-coding.signal: an NL ask to WRITE a file/module/script/library that names or lists more than one function/unit (a discrete coding task, not a question)
discrete-multi-unit-coding.read: treat it as a BUILD, not a turn: detect the shape from plain language; decompose into the INDEPENDENT units (the named functions); compute the structure (decomposition, assembly, validation) mechanically; draw ONLY the unit bodies from the model, CONCURRENTLY (bounded by parallelism); extract EXACTLY the named unit from each draw (split on definition boundaries — a draw often emits every function it saw, which duplicates the file if the whole reply is kept); assemble and validate — a real testCommand gates; else the hard validator gates (validatePython: pyodide compile+AST undefined-name scan+exec; validateHtml: structure), and only a language with no validator falls to a syntax parse, disclosed as UNVERIFIED. The gate is the strongest the language allows, never weaker than compile+run. The structure is computed, only the units are generated, and the test decides. FLOOR vs MEANING (measured): the hard validator passes the MODULE (compile+ast+exec of the definitions, plus a smoke), NOT the code behavior — a module whose function raises on CALL passes the validator cleanly (normalize returns a list; parse_line calls .split on it -> AttributeError on call; validator ok:true, zero findings). So compile+exec is the structural FLOOR; only a testCommand that actually CALLS the code decides meaning.
discrete-multi-unit-coding.falsifying: a discrete build whose units DEPEND on each other text (so concurrent assembly is incoherent) — then it is a chain, not a fan, and this path is wrong; or a build whose assembled file fails its own test while a single draw passed, which concedes decomposition lost something

local-model-app-build.signal: building a real app or tool with the local model (make the tests pass / a working surface) — the teachable method, not a single task
local-model-app-build.read: THE METHOD (teach it to fish): 1) VISION-FIRST — write a VISION.md declaring the goal, the architecture, the appendages (stub modules whose docstrings are the specs), the quality bar (a real test gate), and the declared task; the vision is the prompt. 2) LAY THE APPENDAGES — stub functions + a real test suite that gates the whole app; the test is the judge, never the labels. 3) THE VOID-CHASING BUILD (capability:void-chasing-build) — for each void: BOX computes mechanical shapes from the docstring (penelope's 'an a priori unit is COMPUTED, never drawn'), HUNT snips a real implementation from the field/workspace + GitHub/web by address, the SWARM (literal/structural/adversarial ants) gates, and the MODEL (1.5B) draws only the irreducible residue from a completion anchor; the real test decides every round, failing changes revert, the arrow-of-time gate rides Kelsen's validity-window precedence, HUNT-FIRST walls a unit that keeps failing and moves on. 4) APPEND-ONLY LOG + PROVENANCE — every action logged with the model disclosed on every line (box = no model, qwen2.5-coder = local); the codebase is the fold of the log; PROVENANCE.md traces every idea and byte to its source. 5) THE SURFACE — the vision's thin shell, rebuilt through the image->HTML tool (cv2html: screenshot -> OCR + pixel analysis -> HTML), wired to the engine. 6) REASON FROM ALL ANGLES — the ant-swarm with the local model as the ants frames 'what X really is' from literal/structural/adversarial framings and converges on the surviving reading. 7) FALSIFY BY REAL BEHAVIOR — never trust labels or the model's say-so: hit the real routes/tests and compare, reporting MATCH/FALSIFIED. 8) RE-CREATE WITH NO EXTRA HELP — a recreate.mjs reads the vision's declared task and rebuilds the whole app.
local-model-app-build.falsifying control: a build that trusts the model's or the labels' say-so without the real test judging; an artifact with a log line missing its model; a surface not wired to real behavior; a claim of 'working' not reproduced by recreate.mjs from the vision alone — any concedes the method

weft-carries-the-cast.signal: a built weft pass (WeftEntry) is consumed by janus's stage-8 kind induction (weftReferents) but carries no cast[]/standing; or a kind induction judged on a weft whose referent set came from edges alone
weft-carries-the-cast.read: the weft pass MUST carry cast[] — the reader's OWN admitted referents (extractSurfaces + discoverReferents), each standing:'referent' — so weftReferents filters to both-bound beings. WeftEntry@2 dropped it; @3 carries it (readToWeft), and weftReferents gates the edges fallback to cast members when a cast is present. Without it, every edge-end (common nouns included: colonies, gravity, lung) is a 'referent' and kind induction is judged on a polluted company graph — the falsifier then fires on the pollution, not the law. Restoring the cast cleaned the kinds (names, not nouns) and removed the union-find percolation blob (one 458-member blob -> kinds <=10). identity-at-a-point.signal: a request to decide whether two mentions are the SAME being (coreference/identity), or an identity claim over a folded record
identity-at-a-point.read: identity is detected as the UNIVERSE FOLDED AT A POINT, following the INDUCED-KINDS DEPENDENCY ORDER, from a particular FOR-WHOM, bounded by DMD. Four seats, each an organ: (1) a referent is the fold at a point (surfaces.js:7, fold.js; Ise, kernel/identity.js — permanence through rebuilding); (2) kinds relate by resemblance in a GRAPH, never a strict tree (Xunzi, kernel/kind-graph-structure.js: relation_diversity_depth, the predicate set) and identity is read off a being's POSITION in that dependency order; (3) identity exists ONLY FOR-WHOM (S113; kernel/for-whom.js — a frame: for whom/giver, for what/question, under what/priors, on what field/ground, through what/medium, by what knowing); (4) the read is BOUNDED BY DMD (Koopman, kernel/dmd.js + rewrite-gate.js). Detection: two mentions are one being iff (a) same kind-dependency position, (b) stable under more record (re-key without erasing, P3), (c) the fold settles or cycles under the DMD bound (not a flatline, not carrying). No capital, no POS, no word list — the seats are the text's own, the kinds', the for-whom's, and the trajectory's.
identity-at-a-point.falsifying: a pair a DIFFERENT for-whom reads as two beings (or one) with NO new material (identity is not for-whom-relative); an identity whose kind-dependency position FLIPS under a farther asOf on the same record; or an identity declared with NO DMD bound matching the bounded fold — any breaks the rule

the-readers-nomos.signal: a claim about the reader's growing priors, what carries across books, the for-whom as accumulation, or reading a corpus in order with accumulated expectations
the-readers-nomos.read: the reader's FOR-WHOM is the accumulation of expectations of how IDENTITIES and KINDS normally behave, sedimented in publication order; janus canonicalizes those expectations into NOMOS (janus/native/organs/nomos.js — 'the ledger of the rules of reading'), which feeds back as the priors khora reads by. CAST DOES NOT CARRY (a referent is the fold at a point, per book; earlier individuals never join a later book's cast); BEHAVIOR DOES (a growing prior over how kinds behave, canonicalized into nomos). Surprise is the ground so far (surprise-segments.js, Rubin: 'the ground was most wrong') plus the delta to the holograph (bayes-surprise.js, Itti & Baldi). The chronologic key is khora/native/eval/weft/chronology.mjs (a derived year from each doc's own front matter — a signal that may be wrong; a year-unknown doc is a TYPED gap, never defaulted to now). Recorded whole in 3.0/the-readers-nomos.md.

the-canonical-cycle.signal: a question about the reader's cycle, what makes it fully activated/canonical, or the loop read -> surprise -> expectations -> nomos -> priors -> read
the-canonical-cycle.read: the cycle is the NINE operators applied to the log, not a new N-step process: NUL (open the void) -> SIG (the difference) -> INS (admit the being; cast, per book) -> SEG (segment in publication time + cut where the ground was most wrong) -> (FLD∨HNT∨MTH, mouth-last) -> CON (link: how the KIND behaves, P(relation|kind)) -> DEF (the nomos row: standing/giver/binding/address) -> EVA (corroborate against the null) -> REC (record + feed the next void), with SYN the seal realizing the licensed rule into a prior khora reads by. Closing edge REC ↬ NUL = agentic. LAWS: cast does NOT carry (a referent is the fold at a point, per book) but behavior does; a rule is GIVEN or EXTRACTED, never REVEALED; no self-confirmation (a candidate is a law only when a null licenses it); the loop is the log's projection (re-key without erasing, P3; replay P159); an expectation the reader does not read by is decorative. ACTIVATION (2026-10-07): active = NUL/SIG/INS/DEF(static priors); built-but-inert = EVA (fold-at imports bayes-surprise.predict but reports wired:false), SEG (surprise organs exist, no read path calls them); missing = CON's behavior object, REC's derived-prior overlay in loadPriors, SYN, and the chronological ordered read (builder reads sharded). The minimal activation closes the loop on one book: read book1 -> surprise -> extract ONE kind-behavior expectation -> write it a derived-prior CANDIDATE (builder+source+witnesses) -> nomos row -> corroborate on book2 vs the null -> license -> SYN -> loadPriors reads it -> read book2 with it and show the surprise shift. Recorded whole in 3.0/the-canonical-cycle.md. STONE — THE CONSTITUTIVE SEQUENCE, NAMED (2026-10-08, on user direction): read the nine operators in their fixed dependency order and treat two gates as CONSTITUTIVE — never skipped, never defaulted, never decoration. (1) NUL open the void; (2) SIG the difference — COREFERENT RESOLUTION's ground (extractSurfaces + discoverReferents, the reader's own surfaces, never a word list); (3) INS admit the being — COREFERENT RESOLUTION's act (a mention becomes a cast member ONLY through the identity organ, kernel/identity.js; a referent is the fold at a point, per book); (4) SEG segment in publication time and cut where the ground was most wrong — SURPRISE's cut (surprise-segments.js, Rubin); (5) FLD/HNT/MTH, mouth-last; (6) CON link how the KIND behaves; (7) DEF the nomos row; (8) EVA corroborate the delta against the null — SURPRISE's judgment (bayes-surprise.js, Itti & Baldi; corroboration.js); (9) REC record and feed the next void; SYN the seal. A read is CANONICAL ONLY WITH BOTH: COREFERENT RESOLUTION (SIG+INS — a being is admitted) AND SURPRISE (SEG+EVA — a cut where the ground was most wrong, corroborated against the null). AN EROSION CHECK: a run that reports no surprise because no `ask` was injected (reading.js deriveSurprise is dead without it), that calls EVA wired:false or leaves SEG's surprise organs uncalled, or that proceeds with no admitted cast, has SKIPPED the canonical sequence and MUST say so — it is an incomplete read, not a canonical one. WIRING — RECORDED WHEN THE GATES WERE MADE LIVE (2026-10-08, on user direction): SEG+EVA is now a CALLED organ in the canonical weft read — readToWeft (read-process.mjs, WeftEntry@4) runs native/the-fold/surprise-gate.mjs::surpriseCut over the material's own token stream: it cuts where the ground was most wrong (segmentBySurprise, Rubin) and corroborates against the same reader's shuffled null (draws 20), a bounded declared window (maxTokens 3000, streamCapped disclosed) because the unbounded null ran minutes on a full document. build-weft.mjs aggregates and records figures per pass, so the gate is consumed, never wired-but-unreached. deriveSurprise was verified LIVE wherever the mechanical door is wired: a reader with revise: reviseTextFold (the production session adapter, proxy-runner createSessionReader) profiled surprise on 11 of 36 turns (59 operations) where the same reader with no adapter profiled zero — pinned by native/tests/dynamics-live.test.js, so the S97 inert path cannot silently return. The `ask` door (interrogation.js) is the AGENT/MODEL door the no-model-reasoning rule forbids for a model-free read; the mechanical door is `revise`, which proxy-runner wires and the new dynamics test pins. REMAINING, disclosed: EVA's bayes-surprise significance in fold-at.js is still wired:false (needs a caller-supplied holograph), and the coreference rung at the pronoun level (pronoun->antecedent identity) is still the gap the khora's own commits name.
the-canonical-cycle.falsifying: a CROSS-BOOK CAST LEAK (an earlier book's individual in a later book's cast); a REVEALED nomos row (no giver, no builder) not refused by licenseNomos; a candidate licensed without a null; a rule stored beside the weft rather than folded from it; or a licensed nomos whose presence does not move the next read's surprise — any breaks the rule AND a 'canonical' read that omits either constitutive gate — no admitted being (bare surfaces, no cast; coreferent resolution not run) or no corroborated surprise (deriveSurprise zero with no injected ask; a delta no null licensed; SEG's surprise organs uncalled) — concedes this rule.

Consumers that still read khora/native/priors must re-point or they read a stale copy = drift. Verified: reader-bundle.js::loadPriors resolves janus/priors (grammarPrior true from there). See janus/priors/README.md. A reading-rule number hardcoded in khora code is then a drift-class form the receptacle accreted.

scene-fold.signal: a mechanical fold of a BOOK into action situations / scene-kinds, or a scene/action-situation extraction from an EOT
scene-fold.read: a SCENE is an OSTROM ACTION SITUATION: {positions (Ground) · actors (Figure) · actions->outcomes, valenced (Pattern)} with the EOT's polarity as a weak cost/benefit. Bounded by surprise: opens where the ground is most wrong (Rubin), closes where belief is revised (bayes-surprise to the holograph, admit().bayes = KL delta), typed once/finite/recurring by the DMD of the surprise stream (Koopman). Scenes are cut by the position-vocabulary ground (a NEW role ends a situation). SCENE-KINDS are INDUCED by janus from each scene's {position·action·outcome} company, never taught; priors supply only grammar + the carried ground (expectation), never the kinds. MEASURED (Odyssey, Greek 2026-10-08): genuine kinds emerged (nostos-return, god-scene, cattle-taboo) but the induction is DEGENERATE at surface element grain (the 341-of-405 blob fires the frequency-band falsifier) — the elements must be kinds first (verb lemmas, role-classes, outcome-kinds). See khora/native/eval/the-fold/scene/. Recorded whole in 3.0/the-canonical-cycle.md + identity-at-a-point.md.

openfold-organ-wiring.signal: an architecture ask that points an engine-side organ/ledger at the openfold fork — 'what would it mean to wire X directly into openfold'; the crux is 'directly' (in-process in the fork vs live on openfold's turns through the door); hard also because names collide (kernel/hyperlexicon.js = the affordance ledger/licensing, 'the FIELD – the accumulated ground the reading stands on'; organs/hyperlexicon.js = the notes-ledger text face; openfold = the opencode fork + desktop app, renamed from opencode-fold)
openfold-organ-wiring.read: swarm it (structural + doctrinal + adversarial). Structural: the fork's only delta is packages/core/src/plugin/fold.ts — a thin forwarder (tools snip/swarm/perceive/transcribe; session.text.ended / tool.success are the hearing seams); the engine lives door-side (khora/opencode-doorway.mjs). isthmus-codec.signal: a reasoner, matcher, router or mechanical lane that reads material by its own cut/parse/word list, or with a codec chosen by a code default (lang = "en", ?? "eng", language: "eng" at a call), instead of through THE reader and the material's own codec; or a 'pivot'/'specific grammar' question about the NL -> grammar -> EOT -> reason -> grammar -> NL chain
isthmus-codec.read: THE ISTHMUS (native/docs/THE-ISTHMUS.md, ratified 2026-10-26; keeper Chomsky, enforcement Greenberg shapes 5-6): material -> its CODEC (decode) -> EOT -> reason in EOT -> the target's codec (encode) -> material. A codec is the per-material decode/encode pair (a language's UD tokenizer+parser in, UDGrammar@1 out; image/code/audio adapters are codecs too), so the law is omnimodal. The material chooses the codec (declared or heard); no codec is a typed gap (no_grammar, parser_absent, grammar_absent, no_parser, language_default), never the English codec; one reader, never a second cut. 'Pivot' is retired for this: in the repos it means an English hub, which the Isthmus refuses. Check: node native/organs/greenberg.js --summary <dir>. State 2026-10-26: every piece exists (rowsOfFor, Stage@1, eot-realize, janus nl-eot) and none is joined to a door.
isthmus-codec.falsifying: a serving path that returns a verdict over non-English material with no codec in its trace, or where a typed gap was owed; one claim in two languages landing in different EOT cells after both decode cleanly; a declared language read with another language's codec while labelled declared; or Greenberg shape 5/6 passing on read-atoms.js:32, english-parser.js toEot(..., {language: 'eng'}), arithmetic.js /\bplus\b/, or foldcode physics-mech LISTISH
